# Barpi

> Barpi (barpi.com.ua) is a Ukrainian brand and online store of natural dried treats for dogs and cats. Each treat has one ingredient (beef, chicken or cheese), with no preservatives, colorants or flavorings. Treats are dried in a vacuum at 34–38 °C using the patented SNECO technology and made in Mukachevo, Ukraine. The site is in Ukrainian; prices are in UAH; delivery is within Ukraine.

## Catalog

- [Full catalog](https://barpi.com.ua/kataloh/): all treats, appetizers and sets
- [Treats for dogs](https://barpi.com.ua/naturalni-lasoshchi-dlia-sobak/)
- [Treats for cats](https://barpi.com.ua/naturalni-lasoshchi-dlia-kotiv/)
- [Appetizers (food toppers) for dogs and cats](https://barpi.com.ua/apetaizery-toppery-dlia-sobak-ta-kotiv/): dried pieces in a jar, added to regular food
- [Tasting sets](https://barpi.com.ua/dehustatsiini-nabory-lasoshchiv/): several flavours to try
- [Small packs (15–20 g)](https://barpi.com.ua/lasoshchi-v-malykh-pachkakh/)
- [Beef treats](https://barpi.com.ua/lasoshchi-z-yalovychyny-dlia-sobak-i-kotiv/)
- [Chicken treats](https://barpi.com.ua/lasoshchi-z-kurky-dlia-sobak-i-kotiv/)
- [Cheese treats for dogs](https://barpi.com.ua/syrni-lasoshchi-dlia-sobak/)
- [For small and medium breeds](https://barpi.com.ua/lasoshchi-dlia-malykh-i-serednikh-porid-sobak/)
- [For large breeds](https://barpi.com.ua/lasoshchi-dlia-velykykh-porid-sobak/)

- [Payment and delivery](https://barpi.com.ua/oplata-i-dostavka/): card online (WayForPay) or cash on delivery; Nova Poshta across Ukraine, usually 1–2 days; free delivery from 1000 UAH
